list.name: run_id
list.query: SELECT run_id FROM experiment_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: profile_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT profile_id FROM cost_analyses WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY profile_id

list.name: request_id
list.query: SELECT request_id FROM requests WHERE run_id = '$run_id' ORDER BY client_latency_ms DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Total Cost
panels.description: Total infrastructure cost for the selected run/cost profile.

targets.rawSql: SELECT total_run_cost_usd AS "Total Cost (USD)" FROM cost_analyses WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND profile_id = '$profile_id';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Queries" FROM requests WHERE run_id = '$run_id';

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Successful requests divided by all attempted requests.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS "Success Rate (%)" FROM requests WHERE run_id = '$run_id';

panels.title: Mean Cost / Query
panels.description: Average attributed request cost for the selected profile.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(total_cost_usd) AS "Mean Cost / Query (USD)" FROM request_cost_attributions WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND profile_id = '$profile_id';
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY total_cost_usd) AS "p95 Cost / Query (USD)" FROM request_cost_attributions WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND profile_id = '$profile_id';

panels.title: Tokens / Dollar
panels.description: Total inference tokens divided by selected run cost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN c.total_run_cost_usd = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(COALESCE(i.total_tokens, 0)) / c.total_run_cost_usd END AS "Tokens / Dollar" FROM cost_analyses c LEFT JOIN inference_observations i ON i.run_id = c.run_id WHERE c.run_id = '$run_id' AND c.profile_id = '$profile_id' GROUP BY c.total_run_cost_usd;

panels.title: Experiment Comparison
panels.description: Completed benchmark runs and cost profiles. Compare concurrency, model-serving configuration, run duration, and infrastructure cost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run_id AS "Run ID", profile_id AS "Cost Profile", dataset_mode AS "Dataset", selected_query_count AS "Queries", benchmark_concurrency AS "Concurrency", model AS "Model", max_num_seqs AS "Max vLLM Sequences", total_run_cost_usd AS "Total Cost (USD)", request_cost_sum_usd AS "Request Cost Sum (USD)", duration_seconds AS "Duration (s)" FROM experiment_cost_comparison ORDER BY run_id DESC, profile_id;

panels.title: Agent Cost Share
panels.description: Per-agent execution work, latency, failures, attributed infrastructure cost, and percentage of total run cost. overhead_unallocated is intentionally visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent AS "Agent", calls AS "Calls", cpu_seconds AS "CPU Time (s)", wall_time_ms AS "Wall Time (ms)", p95_latency_ms AS "p95 Latency (ms)", attributed_cost_usd AS "Attributed Cost (USD)", cost_percentage AS "Cost Share (%)", failures AS "Failures" FROM agent_cost_breakdown WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND profile_id = '$profile_id' ORDER BY attributed_cost_usd DESC;

panels.title: Cost / Query Distribution
panels.description: Request-level cost distribution with latency and workload shape.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.query_id AS "Query ID", r.request_id AS "Request ID", r.n_holdings AS "Holdings", r.phrasing AS "Type", r.client_latency_ms AS "Latency (ms)", c.total_cost_usd AS "Cost (USD)", c.cpu_cost_usd AS "CPU Cost", c.gpu_cost_usd AS "GPU Cost", c.overhead_cost_usd AS "Overhead Cost", c.success AS "Success" FROM requests r JOIN request_cost_attributions c ON c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.request_id = r.request_id WHERE r.run_id = '$run_id' AND c.profile_id = '$profile_id' ORDER BY c.total_cost_usd DESC;

panels.title: Selected Request Summary
panels.description: A single request/query view for drilldown into execution, inference, logs, and cost attribution.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.run_id AS "Run ID", r.query_id AS "Query ID", r.request_id AS "Request ID", r.n_holdings AS "Holdings", r.lookback_days AS "Lookback", r.phrasing AS "Type", r.client_latency_ms AS "Client Latency (ms)", r.gateway_queue_wait_ms AS "Gateway Queue Wait (ms)", r.http_status AS "HTTP Status", r.success AS "Success", r.error_type AS "Error Type", c.total_cost_usd AS "Cost (USD)" FROM requests r LEFT JOIN request_cost_attributions c ON c.run_id = r.run_id AND c.request_id = r.request_id AND c.profile_id = '$profile_id' WHERE r.run_id = '$run_id' AND r.request_id = '$request_id';

panels.title: Execution Observations
panels.description: Historical request -> stage -> agent -> tool/ticker observations from exported traces.

targets.rawSql: SELECT observation_id AS "Observation", parent_observation_id AS "Parent", stage AS "Stage", agent AS "Agent", tool AS "Tool", ticker AS "Ticker", started_at AS "Start", finished_at AS "Finish", wall_time_ms AS "Wall Time (ms)", cpu_time_ms AS "CPU Time (ms)", status AS "Status", error_type AS "Error Type", raw->'span'->>'traceID' AS "Trace ID", raw->'span'->>'spanID' AS "Span ID" FROM execution_observations WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND request_id = '$request_id' ORDER BY started_at, finished_at;

panels.title: Inference Observations
panels.description: Exact inference rows. Aggregate vLLM metrics remain run-level telemetry and are not assigned to individual requests.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", elapsed_ms AS "Elapsed (ms)", prompt_tokens AS "Prompt Tokens", completion_tokens AS "Completion Tokens", total_tokens AS "Total Tokens", ttft_ms AS "TTFT (ms)", queue_ms AS "Queue (ms)", prefill_ms AS "Prefill (ms)", decode_ms AS "Decode (ms)", status AS "Status", attempt_count AS "Attempts", retry_count AS "Retries", raw->>'trace_id' AS "Trace ID", raw->>'span_id' AS "Span ID" FROM inference_observations WHERE run_id = '$run_id' AND request_id = '$request_id' ORDER BY started_at;

panels.title: Run-Level Serving Telemetry
panels.description: Prometheus resource and vLLM samples retained as aggregate run-level telemetry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT resource_type AS "Resource", resource_id AS "Series", raw->'metric'->>'name' AS "Metric", MIN(timestamp) AS "First Sample", MAX(timestamp) AS "Last Sample", AVG(COALESCE(cpu_utilization, gpu_utilization, gpu_power_watts, gpu_temperature_c, (raw->>'value')::double precision)) AS "Mean Value", MAX(COALESCE(memory_bytes::double precision, gpu_memory_used_bytes::double precision, gpu_energy_joules, (raw->>'value')::double precision)) AS "Max Value" FROM resource_samples WHERE run_id = '$run_id' GROUP BY resource_type, resource_id, raw->'metric'->>'name' ORDER BY resource_type, "Metric";
